method: v66, rebuilt on the On Point 2026 ALL POLLS FILLED package: 22,357 respondents from every national and state poll, 728 questions, every question modeled for every respondent, turnout from every vote history and intention item, every primary and head to head answer pooled across waves; AP Voter Poll calibration; county up: every candidate strength summed from 3,100 counties; policy layer: each candidate on fifteen live policy questions weighted by the respondents own approval of twelve politicians; dynamic weights: each candidate's group pulls measured from the respondents where they answered and their Trump tie measured from the head to heads, coalitions read through the Pew political types of today's electorate, candidate turnout from the ground up, voter profile simulation, calibrated Gallup and 2026 shifts: 40 previous primary results, 40 candidate quality strength, 20 Gallup party ID with voter types
